svg.title: StreamDecisionBench — single-model leaderboard
svg.desc: 27 single-model settings, 10 cloud APIs and 17 self-hosted open-weight settings. Normalized log-AUC over update intervals of 0.5–8 seconds; one pass for each Wity mode and three for all other settings.
svg.text: Normalized log-AUC over 0.5–8 s · Higher is better
